description: Claude Opus 5 versus Codex gpt-5.6-sol, judged by Opus in a fresh session. TWO HARNESSES, NO OPENCODE -- this is the roster to reach for on a machine with no working opencode at all, since every other preset contains an opencode/DeepSeek slot. A missing opencode agent listing only WARNS now (the listing is flaky, the dispatch is not), so this is about opencode being absent or broken, not about preflight refusing. Both participants enforce their output schema natively, so there is no fenced-JSON extraction path and nothing to re-ask: the most reliable preset, and the closest to upstream's original two-agent lineup. The judge shares a model with debater 'opus', so it is session-independent but not model-independent; the driver warns about that on every run.
